fields.description: Detects possible DLL hijacking of msedge_elf.dll by looking for suspicious image loads, loading this DLL from unexpected locations.
fields.name: Possible DLL Hijacking of msedge_elf.dll
fields.query: event.type="ModuleLoad" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (module.path contains "\msedge_elf.dll" and (not (module.path in ("c:\program files\Microsoft\Edge\Application\*\*","c:\program files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\*\*","c:\program files\Microsoft\EdgeCore\*\*","c:\program files (x86)\Microsoft\EdgeCore\*\*","c:\program files\Microsoft\EdgeWebView\*\*","c:\program files (x86)\Microsoft\EdgeWebView\*\*")))))
